requirements.description: A university student residence must be close to schools and universities. The value is the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14), rounded to 75.

User prefers energy class C or better, so the energy_class filter includes A1, A2, A3, A4, B and C. Area (850 sqm) and capacity (60 people) are not among the available columns and are not filtered here.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, which maps directly to surface_area.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the three extracted requirements: surface_area at least 850 sqm, energy_class A1 through C, and education score at least 75. No location was supplied, so results are ordered by id ascending.
